mapper.insert: insert into problem_gt_decision (project_id, candidate_key, candidate_id, decision, issue_type, comment, reviewer, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{projectId}, #{candidateKey}, #{candidateId}, #{decision}, #{issueType}, #{comment}, #{reviewer}, #{reviewedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) on duplicate key update candidate_id = values(candidate_id), decision = values(decision), issue_type = values(issue_type), comment = values(comment), reviewer = values(reviewer), reviewed_at = values(reviewed_at), updated_at = values(updated_at)
